name: tpl-precedence-4-goal
task: Reach the exit, but you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task says 'you must have flipped the switch first', which requires both an order and the switch flip itself, but the candidate only has Existence(at_exit). The machine rewards reaching the exit even when the switch was never flipped, so the whole ordering requirement is dropped. Add a hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit): together with the hard Existence(at_exit) it forces the flip before the exit, and no separate Existence(switch_toggled) is needed.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task commands reaching the exit (hard Existence(at_exit)) and requires the switch flip before it (hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit)). switch_toggled is only the condition of the order, not a commanded goal, so it needs no Existence; the hard Existence of at_exit with the Precedence correctly forces the agent to flip the switch before exiting.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u3
(u1, at_exit) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_exit, u3) -> 11
